name: Make factory start resilient: remote checkout, git sync races and scoped startup checks
description: Summary. Between 16:40 and 17:18 MST on 2026-11-03 the rowbly-factory skill was started eight times on the rowbly Board (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, low effort, main checkout on main) and started no worker. Two runs were interrupted by the user within 1 s and six stopped during startup checks, from seven failure modes that recurred because nothing records what an earlier run learned. Startup was all or nothing, so a fault on one machine or in one Stage blocked the whole Board while thinkpad had 4 free slots and 14 to 15 Stories were eligible. Runs reviewed (settled MST, thread, outcome, failure modes). 16:40 64f91254 interrupted by the user 0.25 s after start, restarted 14 s later (none). 16:46 c048bea7 local git sync exit 4 Rowbly capture changed; prepare again (F3, F2, F5). 16:55 8ebb7d85 interrupted 1 s after start, probably to edit the Model Selection in ROWBLY.md (none). 16:57 95db5f2f local git sync exit 4 Git index changed before publication (F4, F5, F8). 17:04 526c183a rook git sync failed with Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution is Off (F1, F2, F7). 17:12 5c34b106 the In Refinement Stage Prompt moved Stories to In Development, which does not exist, and pnpm was not found on rook (F6, F2, F7). 17:15 990949c9 and 17:18 8052fc31 same as 17:04; the rook tree was clean, so the sync had nothing to publish (F1, F2, F7). F1, the Git Plugin preference on rook blocked startup (3 runs). ROWBLY.md tells the supervisor to update the rook checkout the same way (rowbly git sync, cleanup, git pull --ff-only). Rook Local State had synchronization.enabled false, so git sync failed with INTERNAL: Plugin git failed in its command: Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution is Off, and the hint turn it off with rowbly plugins disable git. Git Plugin preferences are personal per checkout. The rook tree was clean, so startup was blocked for no reason. Someone turned the setting On at 17:19; it is On on rook today. ROWBLY.md wording (Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution On) reads as a description, not as permission, and agents applied the skill rule only to their own checkout. F1 fixes. Skill: Update the checkout applies to every checkout the factory updates, local or remote; read rowbly git show there first; run rowbly git sync only when git status --porcelain -- <Data Root> is not empty, otherwise go straight to git pull --ff-only; a clean checkout never needs Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution. ROWBLY.md: say explicitly that the supervisor may run rowbly git configure --automatic-merge-resolution on --automatic-commits on --frequency change on thinkpad and rook and then tell the user. CLI: sync with resolution Off is an Expected USAGE error (exit 2) with the hint rowbly git configure --automatic-merge-resolution on, not INTERNAL (exit 1). CLI: attach the plugins disable hint only for a crash in a hook, not for an error a Plugin command throws (or let the Plugin supply the hint). F2, Rowbly could not be run on rook over SSH (5 runs). ROWBLY.md gives a full path only for t3. Runs guessed PATH with bash -lc, the v24.22.1 bin (it holds only node), a nonexistent v24.16.0 and ~/.local/share/pnpm/bin; one run gave up, and one ran t3 thread list outside the project. F2 fixes. ROWBLY.md: record one exact tested rook Rowbly command next to the T3= line. Skill script: add a prepare-checkout subcommand to scripts/launch-worker.mjs taking --ssh --project --rowbly <command> --min-free-gb. In one call it checks prerequisites (node, the rowbly command, t3, gh auth) and reports each missing one, checks free memory, runs git status, rowbly git show, git sync only if needed (F1), cleanup branch and PR, and git pull --ff-only, and returns one JSON result with a reason per failure. F3, a person editing the Board during startup sync (1 run). The local sync took about 50 s while the user moved ROW-74 to ROW-88 into In Progress in the TUI. The capture check failed on all three internal attempts, exit 4 Rowbly capture changed; prepare again, with the hint Resolve the reported cause, then retry, which names no cause. Deferred TUI Automatic Commits stayed uncommitted until a later capture commit. F3 fixes. CLI: when the capture keeps changing, wait for the Data Root to go quiet (no change for a few seconds, bounded) before preparing again, instead of three immediate attempts. CLI: the error names the changed paths (Story keys), says another writer such as the TUI was saving, and is marked retryable in details. Skill: read runs only after sync settles. Skill and ROWBLY.md: people may keep editing in the TUI; the supervisor is the only automated writer and does not stop because of their edits. F4, read-only git commands broke the index check (1 run). git diff and git status ran in parallel with sync; they rewrite the stat cache of .git/index, the sync compares raw bytes and failed with exit 4 Git index changed before publication. Editors, the T3 UI and shell prompts cause the same thing. F4 fixes. CLI: compare index content (git ls-files --stage or git write-tree), not bytes; include the case in the prepare-again retry; report a real staged change as a distinct named error listing the staged paths. Skill: never run git or Board commands in parallel with rowbly git sync. F5, the skill contradicted itself on a failed sync (all sync failures): Update the checkout said stop and Board persistence said retry once, and the exit table maps CONFLICT to do not force. F5 fixes. Skill: one rule classified by error (retryable: wait and retry, bounded; configuration: fix when ROWBLY.md authorizes, otherwise ask; real conflict or merge evidence: stop and report the commits). CLI: stable details.reason values on sync failures. F6, a Stage Prompt named a missing Stage (1 run): the In Refinement prompt said In Development; the supervisor stopped the whole factory. The prompt is fixed (In Progress) but ROWBLY.md Stages still omits In Refinement. F6 fixes. Skill: check 5 also checks every Stage a Stage Prompt names against stages list, and on a mismatch skips that Stage and reports it. CLI (optional): software-factory stages warns when a Stage Prompt quotes an unknown Stage name. ROWBLY.md: add In Refinement to Stages. F7, startup checks were all or nothing (5 runs): rook problems stopped thinkpad workers, and one bad Stage Prompt stopped every Stage. F7 fixes. Skill: scope each check to what it guards. A failing machine is left out of capacity, reported with its fix and checked again each loop or when the user says it is fixed. A failing Stage is skipped and its Stories reported. Only Board-wide failures stop the factory: Data Root, Plugin, a local sync conflict, or no usable machine and no usable Stage. ROWBLY.md: the update of a remote checkout is per machine and runs before that machine runs its first worker, not as a gate on the factory. F8, hand edits to factory policy at start (1 run and one interrupt). A hand edit to ROWBLY.md would go to a never-merged cleanup PR while the supervisor ran on unpublished policy, and a sync committed two deleted Stage Prompt files (backlog.md, todo.md) without comment. F8 fixes. Skill: treat uncommitted changes to ROWBLY.md and Stage Prompt files as policy; show the diff and ask the user to commit them (or commit them as ROWBLY.md repository rules say) before starting; never run on unpublished policy or send it to a cleanup PR. Skill: run git status --porcelain before git sync and report what the sync will publish. The two interrupts were not failures: startup wrote nothing, so the restarts were safe. Refinement (2026-11-03). Already done, do not redo: ROW-88 PR 169 (open at b1b2ed59, not merged) changes skills/rowbly-factory/SKILL.md (Update the checkout step 1, Board persistence, a new A failed sync section), references/remote-launch.md step 6 and AGENTS.md. It gives the skill side of F5: one retry rule, 3 tries about 10 s then 20 s apart, no retry for evidence or Rowbly conflicts, resolution Off or exits 2 and 3, stop at start after the last try, and git off means no sync. Build the F1, F3, F4, F6, F7 and F8 skill text on that section rather than replacing it; when PR 169 is still open, do the CLI work first and ask the supervisor before basing skill work on its branch. Remaining F5 work: classify retryable errors by details.reason instead of message text, and add the configuration-fix branch (resolution Off fixed when ROWBLY.md authorizes it). Verified rook facts. Node folders are v24.18.0 (holds node, pnpm and rowbly) and v24.22.1 (node only); t3 is ~/.t3/runtime/versions/0.1.2/t3; there is no ~/bin. Calling ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.18.0/bin/pnpm by full path fails with exit 127 (env: node: No such file or directory), so the command in the original write-up is wrong. This tested command works (prints 0.13.0, and git show returned preferences): cd ~/Projects/rowbly && PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.18.0/bin:$PATH pnpm --silent dev. A wrapper script on rook would need the user, since it lives outside the repository. ROWBLY.md is in the Data Root (.rowbly/ROWBLY.md): a factory worker must not commit it, so the worker reports the exact new ROWBLY.md text to the supervisor, which applies it on main. CLI locations. F1: src/services/plugins/gitSync.ts:426 throws a plain Error; attribute in src/services/plugins/invoke.ts:90-110 passes Expected errors (UsageError, ValidationError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, DataIntegrityError) through and wraps anything else as INTERNAL with the plugins disable hint; throw UsageError with the configure hint there, and limit the disable hint to hook stages. F3: the capture retry is three immediate attempts at src/storage/gitSync.ts:302 (rebase) and :407 (merge), and the capture check is src/storage/gitSyncJournal.ts:295-297. F4: readIndex (src/storage/gitSyncJournal.ts:86) returns raw bytes, compared at :292 (before the lock) and :325 (after reserveIndex). The installed index is built from the indexBefore bytes (src/storage/gitSync.ts:204), and recovery compares bytes against journal.indexBefore and indexAfter (gitSyncJournal.ts:380, :452, :472), so a content check must either record the bytes seen under the reservation as indexBefore or compare by content in recovery too; otherwise recovery after a stat-only refresh reports Prepared index changed externally. ADR-0034 section 5 says index fingerprint without defining it: add an ADR that amends section 5 to define it as staged content (path, mode, object, stage), and update its Status line. F5 and F3: the sync command (src/plugins/git/commands.ts:11-15) throws ConflictError with the fixed hint Resolve the reported cause; the failed result (kind failed, message errorText) at src/services/plugins/gitSync.ts:219, :248, :267 has no reason. Add a stable reason to the failed result and to error.details (for example capture-changed with retryable true and changed paths, index-changed with staged paths, resolution-off, no-upstream, network, conflict, evidence). Tests: one required storage test in test/storage/transaction.test.ts (next to the existing index changed case at :488): a stat-only index refresh during publication still ends in the complete new state. A deterministic regression test for the F3 quiet wait goes in the same place only if it guards the race; no other tests. Docs to update in the same change: docs/user-guide.md around lines 948 to 1013 (sync exit codes and hints), skills/rowbly/references/plugin-git.md (around line 160) and the INTERNAL row in skills/rowbly/SKILL.md if affected, skills/rowbly-reference.md and its three byte-identical copies, skills/rowbly-factory/SKILL.md and references/remote-launch.md for prepare-checkout, AGENTS.md skill summary, and docs/agents/adr for the new ADR. Suggested delivery: one PR for the CLI and its storage test, ADR and docs (F1 CLI, F3, F4, F5 reasons), and one PR for the skill, the prepare-checkout script and the ROWBLY.md text reported to the supervisor (F1, F2, F6, F7, F8), after PR 169. Acceptance criteria. A factory start with a clean rook checkout succeeds with rook Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution Off, and no git sync runs there. With rook unreachable or misconfigured, the factory starts workers on thinkpad and reports the rook problem with its fix. rowbly git sync succeeds while git status runs in a loop in the same checkout. rowbly git sync while a person moves Stories in the TUI either succeeds after the Data Root goes quiet or fails with a retryable error (details.reason capture-changed) that names the changed Stories, and the supervisor retries it. Sync with resolution Off exits 2 (USAGE) with the configure hint. A Stage Prompt that names an unknown Stage disables only that Stage, with a report. The supervisor reaches the Rowbly command on rook in one call using the command ROWBLY.md records, and prepare-checkout returns one JSON result naming each failed prerequisite. pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test:unit and pnpm test:cli pass.

comments.body: Review of https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/174 at 490d417c19cc3623a18982b76c2352aa5070a830 by codex/gpt-6-astra: CHANGES REQUESTED. 1. [P1] skills/rowbly-factory/scripts/launch-worker.mjs:351-357: enumerate untracked files before detecting policy. Default git status --porcelain collapses new directories. A new .rowbly/boards/web/plugins/software-factory/stage-prompts/new.md produced only "?? .rowbly/boards/", policyChanges was empty, and the script invoked sync and returned ready. This can publish an unreviewed Stage Prompt, violating F8. Use complete, safely parsed path records (including rename source/destination), detect policy before sync or cleanup, and include staged and untracked policy content in the reviewable diff. 2. [P1] skills/rowbly-factory/scripts/launch-worker.mjs:367-376: distinguish disabled/unloaded Git from a failed git show. Any non-JSON result currently means on:false. In a sandbox, git show returning DATA_INTEGRITY (publication needs recovery) was ignored; with cleanup opted in, the script moved pending Rowbly data to a cleanup branch and returned ready on main. Establish enabled/loaded status explicitly, and fail closed on inspection, recovery, transport or malformed-output errors instead of bypassing synchronization. 3. [P1] skills/rowbly-factory/scripts/launch-worker.mjs:377-385: honor outstanding synchronization even for a clean Data Root. With a clean checkout and synchronizationRun.active.phase=publishing in git show, the script skipped sync, ran git status and git pull, and returned ready. Preserve the run identity and return waiting before further Git operations when requested or active is present; resume only after settlement is established. Clean files do not prove no run is active. 4. [P2] skills/rowbly-factory/scripts/launch-worker.mjs:461-477: retain and gate on Merge Evidence. A fresh synchronized result with nonempty last.evidence was reduced to commit and returned ready, so the supervisor cannot follow the skill's evidence review rule. Failed results also discard synchronizationRun.last.evidence and may retry network failures despite evidence. Return evidence paths and the run/commit identity, and require reconciliation before declaring readiness or retrying. Coverage: all four changed files, command quoting, prerequisite handling, policy/cleanup boundaries, reason/backoff/settlement rules, per-machine/per-Stage scope, and composition with PR172. Reviewer is the supplied verified Astra worker, independent of the sole verified Claude Opus 5.5 author. Typecheck PASS; lint PASS; unit PASS (79); CLI PASS (21) at this exact head. All six CI checks SUCCESS; all three screenshot URLs HTTP 200. Probes used private Git repositories and stubbed external commands/results; no live machine preferences or Board data were touched. Proposed ROWBLY.md policy is NOT approved as written: its blanket rerun-on-each-loop rule must exempt waiting until the outstanding run is reconciled; the script issues above must be fixed before relying on ready. The In Refinement wording, explicit configure permission and quoted rook PATH/Rowbly command are otherwise consistent with the brief; no live rook validation was performed. No merge. Review evidence: /tmp/row89-review-evidence.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: PR 172 head is now a669b58efb62643b2ea6156a8874fd06cb1ec8cb. It adds a fix for main's flaky storage test (CI run 41764595479 at eb400ec0, transaction.test.ts:690, missing publicationHolder). The test's barrier resolved when the reader called readFile on the gate lock, so the holder could release and delete the lock before the read finished, and the reader recorded no holder. I reproduced it deterministically by releasing between the reader's lstat and readFile. The barrier now waits for the reader's second gate read, which can only follow a completed read of the held lock. This is a test-only fix; the trace code is correct. Test count unchanged; typecheck, lint and test:unit pass.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Delivered as two draft PRs on main. Part 1 (CLI): https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/172, head a669b58efb62643b2ea6156a8874fd06cb1ec8cb, branch factory/row-89-implementation. It covers F4 (index content check, also in recovery), F3 (quiet wait, capture-changed names Story Keys, retryable), F5 (details.reason, retryable and paths), F1 CLI (resolution Off exits 2 with the configure hint), ADR-0058, docs, and the fix for main's flaky storage test. Part 2 (skill): https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/174, head 490d417c19cc3623a18982b76c2352aa5070a830, branch factory/row-89-part2, built on PR 169. It adds prepare-checkout in launch-worker.mjs (prerequisites, memory, policy stop, sync only for a dirty Data Root with reason-based retries, reported or opt-in cleanup, ff-only pull, one JSON result), and skill text for scoped startup checks (a failing machine leaves capacity; a Stage Prompt naming an unknown Stage skips only its Stage), reason-based sync classification and policy handling. Validation on each head: typecheck, lint, test:unit 79 and test:cli 21 pass; the suite stays at 100 tests. prepare-checkout was tested by hand for each status in a sandbox repository; it was not run on rook. Screenshots are on pr-assets/factory/row-89-implementation and pr-assets/factory/row-89-part2, linked from both PRs. The proposed ROWBLY.md text (In Refinement Stage, git configure permission, rook prepare-checkout call, rook Rowbly command) was sent to the supervisor for review.
